name: paxeer-dev-tracker
description: A daily engineering briefing for Paxeer. Pulls Sidiora-Labs and LayerX-Network from the public GitHub API — pushes, merged PRs (with what changed), open-PR and lane rollups, the latest Paxeer-X-Network commit and stalls, the board, the gates, the observations — and reports what is new since yesterday in plain English. Two agent tools: paxeer_sweep pulls fresh state and briefs; paxeer_brief renders the last snapshot instantly. No key, no account: run it on a schedule and watch it in plain English.
author: schlegelcrypto

x-meta.label: Request timeout
x-meta.help: Seconds to wait for each GitHub request before giving up (2–120). Unauthenticated GitHub allows 60 requests/hour; a quick sweep uses ~5, a full sweep ~25.
